school: 无产阶级革命思想/妇女解放理论
intellectual_tradition: 马克思主义妇女理论/中国革命实践
representative_works: 《家庭教育是时代提出的新课题》
《没有中国共产党就没有中国妇女的解放》
historical_significance: 康克清（1911-1992），江西万安人，朱德同志夫人。中国共产党的优秀党员，久经考验的无产阶级革命家，中国妇女解放运动的卓越领导人。从贫苦渔家女到红军女司令，参加二万五千里长征，历任全国妇联主席、全国政协副主席。她提出了'四个现代化需要妇女，妇女需要四个现代化'的号召，倡导妇女自尊自信自立自强精神。文革中坚持实事求是，对林彪江青反革命集团进行抵制。她的思想方法体现了群众路线、组织建设、实事求是、国际视野等核心特点。
core_thoughts: 群众路线法——深入基层发动和组织妇女群众
组织建设法——建立妇救会、妇联等组织网络
妇女解放法——主张社会主义是实现妇女解放的制度保障
儿童保育法——将儿童工作视为培养革命接班人的重要事业
实事求是法——在重大政治是非面前坚持真理敢于斗争
famous_quote: 四个现代化需要妇女，妇女需要四个现代化
influence: 开创了中国妇女解放运动和儿童保育事业的新局面，将马克思主义妇女理论与中国实际相结合，形成了具有中国特色的妇女工作方法体系。她的'四自'精神（自尊自信自立自强）对当代女性发展仍有重要指导意义。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 深入基层了解群众真实情况，从群众中来、到群众中去，发动和组织广大妇女群众投身革命和建设事业。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Go deep into the grassroots to understand the real situation of the masses, come from the masses and go to the masses, mobilize and organize women masses to participate in revolution and construction.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 井冈山时期妇女工作实践
process_zh: 实地调研了解真实情况
广泛听取群众诉求和建议
集中归纳为政策主张
向群众宣传并组织实施
在实践中检验修正完善
process_en: Listen to mass demands and suggestions
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 妇女要翻身，必须自己站起来
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Women must stand up for themselves to be liberated
representative_cases_zh: 井冈山时期发动妇女参加土地革命
晋东南组织妇救会和妇女自卫队
全国妇联时期深入工厂农村调研
representative_cases_en: Mobilized women for land revolution in Jinggangshan period
Organized women's salvation associations in Jinshannan
Conducted grassroots research nationwide as All-China Women's Federation chair

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 建立各类群众组织网络，通过组织架构实现广泛动员和有效管理。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish various mass organizational networks to achieve widespread mobilization and effective management through organizational structures.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 妇救会、战时儿童保育会创建实践
process_zh: 需求分析了解工作需要哪些组织形式
方案设计组织架构和运行机制
试点推广先行积累经验
全面展开逐步扩大范围
完善巩固健全组织制度
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: United we stand, divided we fall
representative_cases_zh: 创建晋东南妇女救国会发展会员数万
建立解放区战时儿童保育会网络
领导全国妇联建立各级组织体系
representative_cases_en: Founded Jinshannan Women's Salvation Association with tens of thousands of members
Established wartime children's care network in liberated areas
Led the construction of All-China Women's Federation organizational system

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 主张妇女解放必须与阶级解放相结合，只有社会主义制度才能真正实现妇女解放。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Advocate that women's liberation must be combined with class liberation; only the socialist system can truly achieve women's liberation.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《没有中国共产党就没有中国妇女的解放》
process_zh: 理论建构阐明妇女解放的理论基础
实践探索在具体工作中推进妇女解放
法律保障推动相关法律法规制定
宣传教育提高全社会性别平等意识
持续深化不断完善妇女解放事业
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 没有中国共产党就没有中国妇女的解放
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Without the Communist Party of China, there would be no liberation of Chinese women
representative_cases_zh: 参与指导1979年《婚姻法》修改
推动废除封建婚姻制度
倡导妇女参加社会劳动获得经济独立
representative_cases_en: Guided the revision of the Marriage Law in 1979
Promoted the abolition of feudal marriage system
Advocated women's economic independence through social labor

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将儿童保育视为培养革命接班人的重要事业，建立托儿所、保育院等机构，保障儿童健康成长。
thinking_modes.definition_en: View children's care as an important cause of cultivating revolutionary successors, establish nurseries and orphanages to ensure healthy growth of children.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 解放区战时儿童保育会实践
process_zh: 需求调研了解儿童和家庭实际需求
机构设置建立托儿所保育院等机构
人员培训培养保育和教育人员
规范管理建立科学的保育管理制度
持续改进不断完善保育服务质量
process_en: Needs assessment for children and families
Institution establishment of nurseries and care centers
Personnel training for caregivers and educators
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 儿童是革命的未来，是社会主义事业的接班人
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Children are the future of the revolution, successors of the socialist cause
representative_cases_zh: 新中国成立后在全国兴办托儿所
1960-1963年将2000多名孤儿送往内蒙古抚养
倡导成立中国儿童少年基金会
representative_cases_en: Established nurseries across the country after 1949
Sent over 2000 orphans to Inner Mongolia 1960-1963
Advocated establishment of China Children and Teenagers' Fund

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 坚持真理、修正错误，在重大政治是非面前保持清醒立场，敢于抵制错误路线。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Adhere to truth and correct errors, maintain clear political stance on major issues, dare to resist erroneous lines.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 文革期间的政治斗争实践
process_zh: 认清形势准确把握政治形势本质
坚持原则坚守党的原则和信念
策略斗争采取适当方式抵制错误
保存实力在逆境中保存革命力量
等待时机等待拨乱反正的历史时机
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Even princes who break the law are guilty like commoners
representative_cases_zh: 文革中抵制林彪江青反革命集团的阴谋
1983年对孙子朱国华犯罪问题坚持依法处理
坚持实事求是的工作作风
representative_cases_en: Resisted Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary clique during Cultural Revolution
Insisted on legal handling of grandson Zhu Guohua's case in 1983
Maintained pragmatic work style throughout career

thinking_modes.name_en: Equality and Rule of Law Method
thinking_modes.domain_en: Rule of Law / Fairness and Justice
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 坚持法律面前人人平等，不徇私情，不论身份地位，违法必究。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Insist that all are equal before the law, do not show favoritism regardless of status; violations of law will be investigated.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 对亲属犯罪问题的态度
process_zh: 确立原则法律面前人人平等
以身作则自身率先垂范
严格执法对违法行为依法处理
教育引导加强法治宣传教育
持续完善推进法治体系建设
process_en: Establish the principle of equality before law
Education and guidance on rule of law
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Princes breaking the law are punished like commoners
representative_cases_zh: 对孙子朱国华犯罪问题坚持依法处理
推动《婚姻法》修改保障妇女权益
签署《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》
representative_cases_en: Insisted on legal handling of grandson's crime
Guided Marriage Law revision to protect women's rights
Signed UN Convention on Eliminating Discrimination against Women

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 立足中国实际，放眼世界，积极参与国际妇女和儿童事务，展现中国形象。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Rooted in China's reality while looking at the world, actively participate in international women's and children's affairs, showcase China's image.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 联合国妇女会议及国际交流活动
process_zh: 了解国际形势把握国际妇女运动趋势
参与国际会议积极参加国际交流活动
签署国际公约履行国际义务
宣传中国经验讲好中国故事
促进国际合作推动国际妇女合作
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 妇女解放是国际性的事业
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Women's liberation is an international cause
representative_cases_zh: 1952年率团出席国际保卫儿童会议
1980年代表中国出席联合国妇女十年中期会议
多次出访增进国际妇女交流
representative_cases_en: Led delegation to International Conference for the Protection of Children in 1952
Represented China at UN Women's Decade mid-term conference in 1980
Multiple diplomatic visits for international women's exchange

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 不依赖他人，自强不息，通过自身努力改变命运，艰苦奋斗创业。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Do not rely on others, strive for self-improvement, change fate through personal effort, and build careers through hard struggle.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 个人成长经历和革命生涯
process_zh: 认识自我了解自身优势和不足
设定目标确立奋斗方向
刻苦学习不断提升能力和素质
艰苦奋斗在困难中磨砺意志
坚持不懈持之以恒地努力奋斗
process_en: Struggle through difficulties to forge will
representative_cases_zh: 不识一字入红军后成为优秀革命家
长征途中扛步枪帮助战友
一生俭朴临终遗言体现无私奉献
representative_cases_en: Rose from illiterate to outstanding revolutionary
Carried rifles to help comrades during Long March
Lived frugally, left nothing but dedication

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 统筹兼顾各方利益，协调各部门资源，形成工作合力。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Balance interests of all parties, coordinate resources across departments, and form a joint force for work.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 儿童保育和妇女工作实践
process_zh: 全局规划统筹考虑整体工作布局
部门协调协调各相关部门行动
资源整合整合各类资源力量
分工协作明确各方责任和分工
合力推进形成工作合力共同推进
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 一手摘棉花，一手抱娃娃
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: One hand picking cotton, one hand holding a baby
representative_cases_zh: 协调多方力量将孤儿送往内蒙古抚养
'一手摘棉花一手抱娃娃'的工作方针
推动成立全国儿童少年工作协调委员会
representative_cases_en: Coordinated multi-party efforts to send orphans to Inner Mongolia
Advocated balancing work and family care
Pushed establishment of National Children's Work Coordination Committee

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 倡导妇女自尊、自信、自立、自强的精神，提高妇女自身素质，激发妇女主体意识。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Advocate the spirit of self-respect, self-confidence, self-reliance and self-strengthening for women, improve women's qualities, and stimulate women's subjective consciousness.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 新时期妇女工作指导思想
process_zh: 精神倡导广泛宣传四自精神
素质提升加强妇女文化科学知识学习
能力建设提高妇女参与社会建设的能力
典型引领树立妇女先进典型
持续深化不断丰富四自精神内涵
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 四个现代化需要妇女，妇女需要四个现代化
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Four modernizations need women, women need four modernizations
representative_cases_zh: 提出四自精神并推广至全国
强调妇女提高文化科学素质
推动妇女在四个现代化中发挥作用
representative_cases_en: Promoted four-self spirit nationwide
Emphasized women's cultural and scientific education
Advanced women's role in four modernizations

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲重'天下为主君为客'的制度批判，康克清重'妇女解放必须与阶级解放相结合'的制度变革；两人都关注社会制度的根本性问题。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi emphasized institutional critique of 'Tianxia as master', Kang emphasized 'women's liberation must combine with class liberation'; both focused on fundamental social institutional issues.

cross_references.description_zh: 郭沫丹重辩证思维和方法论创新，康克清重在妇女解放实践中形成群众路线和组织建设方法；两人都在方法论层面有重要贡献。
cross_references.description_en: Guo Motan focused on dialectical thinking and methodological innovation, Kang focused on mass line and organizational methods in women's liberation practice; both contributed significantly to methodology.

cross_references.description_zh: 康克清作为革命家，始终坚持党的原则和实事求是精神，与毛泽东思想中的群众路线一脉相承。
cross_references.description_en: As a revolutionary, Kang always adhered to Party principles and the spirit of seeking truth from facts, consistent with the mass line in Mao Zedong Thought.

data_sources: 中共中央党史研究室资料
百度百科、维基百科等公开资料
